passages.text: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
passages.sermon:
John the Baptist was a preacher.
He came during those days.
He went to the wilderness of Judea.
He preached there.
He said, “Repent.”
He said, “The kingdom of heaven is near.”
passages.original: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ λέγων Μετανοεῖτε ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν

passages.text: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’ ”
passages.sermon:
John the Baptist preached in the wilderness of Judea.
The prophet Isaiah spoke about him long ago.
Isaiah said, “A voice calls out in the wilderness.”
The voice says, “Prepare the way for the Lord.”
The voice says, “Make straight paths for Him.”
passages.original: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ

passages.text: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
passages.sermon:
John was a preacher.
John baptized people.
John lived in the wilderness of Judea.
John wore a garment made from camel’s hair.
John wore a leather belt around his waist.
John ate locusts.
John ate wild honey.
passages.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον

passages.text: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
John preached in the wilderness near the Jordan River.
People heard about John.
People left Jerusalem to go to John.
People from all Judea went to John.
People from the whole region around the Jordan went to John.
passages.original: Τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου

passages.text: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
passages.sermon:
People came to John.
They confessed their sins.
John baptized them.
He baptized them in the Jordan River.
passages.original: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν

passages.text: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
passages.sermon:
John was a prophet.
John baptized people in the Jordan River.
John saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming to be baptized by him.
The Pharisees and Sadducees were religious leaders.
John spoke to them.
John said, "You brood of vipers."
John asked, "Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?"
passages.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς

passages.text: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
passages.sermon:
John spoke to the Pharisees and Sadducees.
He told them to produce fruit.
This fruit must match true repentance.
Their actions must show real change in their hearts.
passages.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας

passages.text: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
passages.sermon:
John spoke to the Pharisees and Sadducees.
He warned them not to rely on their ancestry.
He said, “Do not say to yourselves, ‘Abraham is our father.’”
God has great power.
God can make children for Abraham from these stones.
Your heritage does not guarantee your place with God.
God can create His people from anyone, even from stones.
passages.original: καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ

passages.text: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
passages.sermon:
God stands ready to judge.
The axe lies at the root of the trees.
God will cut down every tree that does not produce good fruit.
God will throw these trees into the fire.
passages.original: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται

passages.text: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
passages.sermon:
John the Baptist speaks to the people.
John baptizes people with water.
This baptism is for repentance.
Someone will come after John.
This person is more powerful than John.
John is not worthy to carry this person’s sandals.
This person will baptize the people with the Holy Spirit.
This person will also baptize the people with fire.
passages.original: Ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί

passages.text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus holds the winnowing fork in His hand.
He will clear His threshing floor.
He will gather His wheat into the barn.
He will burn the chaff with unquenchable fire.
passages.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ

passages.text: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
At that time, Jesus traveled from Galilee.
He came to the Jordan River.
John was at the Jordan River.
Jesus came to John.
Jesus wanted John to baptize Him.
passages.original: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
passages.sermon:
John was a prophet.
John saw Jesus come to him at the Jordan River.
John tried to stop Jesus.
John said, “I need You to baptize me.”
John said, “Do You come to me?”
passages.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με

passages.text: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to John.
Jesus said, “Allow it now.”
Jesus said, “It is right for us to do this.”
Jesus said, “In this way, we fulfill all righteousness.”
John agreed.
John permitted Jesus.
passages.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ἄφες ἄρτι οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτόν

passages.text: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
John baptized Jesus in the Jordan River.
Jesus came up out of the water immediately after being baptized.
At that moment, the heavens opened.
Jesus saw the Spirit of God coming down.
The Spirit of God came down like a dove.
The Spirit rested on Jesus.
passages.original: Βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί καὶ εἶδεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν καὶ ἐρχόμενον ἐπ’ αὐτόν

passages.text: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
passages.sermon: God spoke from heaven.\r\nGod said, “This is my beloved Son.”\r\nGod said, “I am well pleased with Him.”
passages.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα
